## Written offer

If you cannot get any of the source named here from the places above, or an upstream address named below no
longer works, ask for it in the project's issue tracker, {{issue_tracker}} (open an issue titled "LGPL source
request {{version}}"), and the project will provide a copy, on a physical medium if you ask, charging no more than
the cost of physically performing the distribution. This offer is valid for {{offer_years}} years from the date
you received this SDK and for as long as this release is offered for download.
